title: Renting a bike
instructions: Turist Paolo bisiklet kiralıyor. Süre, fiyat ve kurallara dikkat et.

script.speaker: paolo
script.text: Hi. How much is it to rent a bike?

script.speaker: staff
script.text: It's five pounds an hour, or twenty pounds for the whole day.

script.speaker: paolo
script.text: I'd like one for the whole day, please. I want to ride along the river.

script.speaker: staff
script.text: Good choice. The river path is beautiful. Here is a helmet. You must wear it.

script.speaker: paolo
script.text: OK. What time do I need to bring the bike back?

script.speaker: staff
script.text: We close at six, so before six, please.

script.speaker: paolo
script.text: And do I need to leave anything?

script.speaker: staff
script.text: Yes, I need your passport or your driving licence.

questions.prompt: How much is a bike for the whole day?
questions.feedback: Bütün gün yirmi pound; saatlik beş pound.
questions.evidence: twenty pounds for the whole day.

questions.prompt: Where does Paolo want to go?
questions.feedback: Nehir boyunca (along the river) bisiklet sürmek istiyor.
questions.evidence: I want to ride along the river.

questions.feedback: Kask takmak zorunda (You must wear it).
questions.evidence: Here is a helmet. You must wear it.

questions.prompt: What does Paolo leave at the shop?
questions.feedback: Pasaport ya da ehliyet istenir; Paolo ehliyetini (driving licence) bırakıyor.
